_doc: Config for scripts/mdc_convert.py (Cursor .mdc → CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules / .claude/skills / SPEC.md). Keys starting with _ are ignored. 'spec' lists rule slugs (file stems) routed into SPEC.md managed blocks; 'map' forces a target per slug: claude | rule | skill | spec. Unlisted rules follow the alwaysApply/globs/description table in CLAUDE.md.
